content_html:
Very Rich Perfume from the Rich Vibes Collection — A Luxurious Fragrance That Leaves a Lasting Impression!

Immerse yourself in a world of refined emotions with Very Rich Perfume from the Rich Vibes Collection by Be Trendy. This fragrance is designed for those who capture attention not with words, but with their presence.

Very Rich opens with fresh marine accords that evoke a sense of freedom, lightness, and the refreshing breeze of the sea. At the heart of the fragrance, exquisite gourmand notes of pistachio and sea salt unfold, creating a modern, stylish, and truly unforgettable fragrance character.

Floral nuances bring softness and harmony to the composition, while a warm woody trail envelops the skin in a noble resonance that stays with you throughout the day. This contrast of freshness, subtle sweetness, and woody depth makes Very Rich truly unique and multidimensional.

Top Notes: Jasmine, Sea Salt, Ozone

Heart Notes: Peach, Dried Fruits, Hemp

Base Notes: Coconut, Cedarwood, Musk

Trail: Powdery Notes, Sea Salt

 

Why Choose Very Rich Perfume?

  • A unique blend of fresh marine and gourmand notes
  • Modern and trend-inspired fragrance profile
  • Harmonious balance of freshness, salty accents, and delicate florals
  • A noble woody trail
  • Perfect for both everyday wear and special occasions

 

Who Is Very Rich Perfume For?

  • Lovers of modern gourmand fragrances looking for something more distinctive than traditional sweet or fresh scents.
  • Active individuals who appreciate light, energetic, yet sophisticated compositions.
  • Those who wish to highlight their individuality, as the unique combination of pistachio and sea salt leaves a highly recognizable scent trail.
  • Fans of marine-inspired scents seeking greater depth through floral and woody notes.
  • Those who prefer versatile fragrances with a modern character and a comfortable scent trail.

Perfect For

  • Everyday wear
  • Work and business meetings
  • Walks and travel adventures
  • Romantic dates
  • Special occasions and evening events

 

What Mood Does It Create?

Very Rich Perfume brings a sense of lightness, freedom, confidence, and inner luxury. It highlights your individuality, sets a special mood, and leaves behind an exquisite, unforgettable fragrance.

 

How to Use

Spray the perfume onto clean, dry skin from a distance of 15–20 cm (6–8 inches). The fragrance develops best on the body's warm pulse points:

  • Wrists
  • Neck
  • Behind the ears
  • Inner elbows
  • Décolleté area

The warmth of the skin helps the fragrance gradually reveal its notes, from refreshing marine accords to its sophisticated woody trail.

For Better Longevity

  • Apply the fragrance after showering to moisturized skin.
  • If desired, lightly mist your hair or clothing, ensuring the product does not leave marks on fabric.
  • Avoid rubbing the fragrance after application, as this may alter the natural development of the scent and accelerate the evaporation of the top notes.
